title: Text model aliases take new routes
summary:
Text model aliases changed routes, text errors got easier to read, and image requests gained a token fallback.

`openai-large` now routes to `gpt-4o-mini` instead of `gpt-4o`, while `openai-reasoning` routes to `o1-mini` instead of `o3-mini`.

Errors now preserve upstream HTTP statuses when available and return simpler messages with parsed details. Streaming content-filter failures return "Content policy violation detected" with a `content_policy` flag.

When an image request supplies no token directly, token extraction can check the `Referer` or `Referrer` header.
